metadata.sourceBoundary: Private fixture values are display references. The ordinal learner receives only presence and requested -1/0/+1 comparison witnesses.
metadata.limits: Landmark rank and repeated sampling do not establish distance, equal spacing, a probability model, or a nominal size series.
metadata.historyPolicy: The landmark budget limits retained comparison anchors; this small fixture deliberately retains all visits and their witnesses.

scenarios.title: An irregular signal
scenarios.description: Presence and relative ordering, with repeated values and a limited landmark budget.

scenarios.title: The same signal, rescaled
scenarios.description: Private values become 100 × value + 1000. Presence is unchanged, including missing samples.

scenarios.title: A tiny change inside a broad interval
scenarios.description: 90 and 110 mile anchors, then 100 miles and 100 miles + 1 mm. Distances are manually chosen test data.
